IndianOil and the petroleum ministry have rallied to support Shelke's family during this devastating period.

candidates.title: Tejashwi Yadav, Misa Bharti, Mukesh Sahani detained during SIR protest in Patna
candidates.excerpt: Mahagathbandhan leaders and workers protested in Patna against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. Tensions with police led to the detention of Tejashwi Yadav, Misa Bharti and Mukesh Sahani amid heavy security arrangements

candidates.title: KTR condoles demise of veteran actor Nana Patekar
candidates.excerpt: BRS working president KT Rama Rao expressed grief over the demise of veteran actor Nana Patekar, praising his intense performances and lasting contribution to Indian cinema while extending condolences to his family and admirers.

candidates.title: KTR condemns alleged misconduct by Congress MLA, detention of woman journalist
candidates.excerpt: BRS working president KT Rama Rao condemned the alleged inappropriate behaviour of Congress MLA Malreddy Rangareddy towards a woman on an RTC bus and also criticised the alleged detention of journalist Rekha by Cyber Crime police over her reporting on allegations involving the Chief Minister's family.

candidates.title: KTR asks Musk to name ‘oligarchs’ blocking Starlink in India
candidates.excerpt: BRS working president KT Rama Rao backed Elon Musk's remarks on Starlink's India entry, urging him to identify the alleged oligarchs he claimed were blocking the satellite internet service. The Centre, however, dismissed Musk's allegations as baseless.

candidates.title: Madurantakam Counting Centre Under 3-Tier Security: Collector
candidates.excerpt: The Electronic Voting Machines (EVMs), which were taken to the Integrated Social Development Training Centre at Aathur, were sealed in front of the agents of the candidates, election observers, district collector and superintendent of police

candidates.title: Act on Long-Pending Civic Issues Before Monsoon, Adyar Residents Tell Minister
candidates.excerpt: Residents and traders in Besant Nagar, Thideer Nagar and Thiruvanmiyur flagged issues which are continuing despite repeated complaints to the officials

candidates.title: FIR Against Rahul, Priyanka for 'Assaulting' Police Personnel
candidates.excerpt: Police said a total of 91 people were detained during the protest, including multiple MPs and leaders
